title: The Shade That Ate the Mine
story: Deep in the Hollowdeep copper mine, Glomburr the Pitch Shade stretches its shadow down the main tunnel, and every miner it covers falls fast asleep where they stand. Mr 6 finds three ancient silver mirrors bolted to the walls, each buried under years of soot. Uncovering one makes the shade flinch and shrink — but Mr 6 wants to know if three will be enough before he starts scrubbing.
question: Glomburr's shadow is 96 feet long, and uncovering each mirror shrinks the shadow to three quarters of its current length. How long is the shadow after Mr 6 uncovers all three mirrors?
solution: First mirror: 96 x 3/4 = 72 feet of shadow left.
Second mirror: 72 x 3/4 = 54 feet; third mirror: 54 x 3/4 = 40.5 feet.
The shadow ends up 40.5 feet long.
praise: Shrinking by a quarter each time was the right idea — the trick is that each quarter comes off the NEW length, not the original 96 feet.
hint: After the first mirror the shadow is shorter, so the second mirror takes its quarter from that shorter length. Work one mirror at a time.
victory: At 40.5 feet the shade was too short to reach the sleeping miners, and it slunk off to sulk in a broom closet. Mr 6 polished the mirrors one last time and declared the tunnel officially un-spooky.
imagePrompt: A deep copper mine tunnel where an inky living shadow stretches over sleeping miners, three uncovered silver mirrors throwing bright beams, and a small numeral-6 knight with a polishing rag standing in the light.n
